answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 156555 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Can I do tayammum on the wall of my house which has oil paint on it? Question: Can I do tayammum on the wall of my house which has oil paint on it? Answer ID: 156555 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 252/211/N=3/1439) Tayammum is only permitted on things which are from the genera of the earth and it is not valid to do tayammum on such thing which is not from the genera of the earth. A wall which is painted with oil, if something was applied on the wall before painting it which was not from the genera of the earth and the colour which was mixed in the oil paint is also not from the genera of the earth then in such a case tayammum would not be valid on wall painted with oil. فيجوز – التيمم – كحجر مدقوق أو مغسول وحائط مطين أو مجصص وأوان من طين غير مدهونة الخ (الدر المختار مع رد المتار ، كتاب الطهارة ، باب التيمم، 4061، ط: مكتبة زكريا ديوبند)، قوله: "غير مدهونة": أو مدهونة بصبغ هو من جنس الأرض كما يستفاد من البحر (1: 258، ط: مكتبة زكريا ديوبند) كالمدهونة بالطفل والمغرة ، ط (1: 128، ط: مكتبة الاتحاد ديوبند) (رد المحتار). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
